questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Amalni bajaring: 48 - 18 : 3 + 4 × 5
questions.explanation:
Amallar tartibi bo'yicha avval bo'lish va ko'paytirish bajariladi:
1) 18 : 3 = 6
2) 4 × 5 = 20
3) 48 - 6 + 20 = 42 + 20 = 62.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: 250 sonining 20% ini toping.
questions.explanation:
Sonning foizini topish uchun son foizga ko'paytirilib, 100 ga bo'linadi:
(250 × 20) : 100 = 5000 : 100 = 50.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Mahsulot narxi avval 20% ga oshirildi, so'ngra yangi narx 20% ga kamaytirildi. Boshlang'ich narx qanday o'zgardi?
questions.explanation:
Boshlang'ich narxni 100 deb olsak:
1) 20% oshganda: 100 + 20 = 120.
2) 120 ning 20% i: 120 × 0.2 = 24. Yangi narx: 120 - 24 = 96.
100 - 96 = 4% ga kamaygan.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Qisqa ko'paytirish formulasini hisoblang: (x + 3)² ochilganda qanday ifoda hosil bo'ladi?
questions.explanation:
(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² formulasi bo'yicha:
(x + 3)² = x² + 2×x×3 + 3² = x² + 6x + 9.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Chiziqli tenglamani yeching: 3x - 7 = 2x + 5
questions.explanation:
Noma'lumlarni chap tomonga, sonlarni o'ng tomonga o'tkazamiz:
3x - 2x = 5 + 7
x = 12.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Kvadrat tenglamaning ildizlari yig'indisini toping (Viyet teoremasi): x² - 7x + 10 = 0
questions.explanation: Keltirilgan kvadrat tenglamada (x² + px + q = 0) ildizlar yig'indisi x₁ + x₂ = -p ga teng. Bu yerda p = -7, demak x₁ + x₂ = -(-7) = 7.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Kvadrat tenglamaning ildizlarini toping: x² - 5x + 6 = 0

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Ifodaning qiymatini hisoblang: √144 + √25 - √49
questions.explanation:
Ildizlarni chiqaramiz:
√144 = 12
√25 = 5
√49 = 7
12 + 5 - 7 = 10.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Hisoblang: 2⁵ × 2³ : 2⁶
questions.explanation:
Daraja qoidalariga ko'ra asoslar bir xil bo'lsa, ko'paytirishda darajalar qo'shiladi, bo'lishda ayiriladi:
2^(5 + 3 - 6) = 2² = 4.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Tomonlari a = 6 sm va b = 8 sm bo'lgan to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakning gipotenuzasini (c) toping.
questions.explanation:
Pifagor teoremasi: c² = a² + b²
c² = 6² + 8² = 36 + 64 = 100
c = √100 = 10 sm.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Radiusi R = 7 sm bo'lgan doiraning yuzini toping (π ≈ 22/7 deb oling).

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Ixtiyoriy uchburchakning ichki burchaklari yig'indisi necha gradusga teng?
questions.explanation: Evklid geometriyasida har qanday tekis uchburchakning ichki burchaklari yig'indisi doimo 180° ga teng.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Agar f(x) = 2x² - 3x + 1 bo'lsa, f(3) ning qiymatini toping.
questions.explanation:
Funksiyaga x o'rniga 3 qo'yamiz:
f(3) = 2×(3)² - 3×3 + 1 = 2×9 - 9 + 1 = 18 - 9 + 1 = 10.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: y = kx + b chiziqli funksiyada k koeffitsient nimani ifodalaydi?
options: To'g'ri chiziqning burchak koeffitsientini (og'ish burchagi tangensini)
questions.explanation: Chiziqli funksiyadagi k kattalik burchak koeffitsienti bo'lib, to'g'ri chiziqning Ox o'qining musbat yo'nalishi bilan hosil qilgan burchak tangensiga teng (k = tg α).

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Oddiy o'yin zarcha (kubik) bir marta tashlanganda, juft son (2, 4, 6) tushish ehtimolligi qancha?
questions.explanation: Jami mumkin bo'lgan natijalar n = 6 ta. Qulay natijalar m = 3 ta (2, 4, 6). Ehtimollik P = m/n = 3/6 = 1/2 (50%).

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Qutida 4 ta qizil va 6 ta ko'k shar bor. Tavakkaliga bitta shar olinganda, uning qizil bo'lish ehtimolligi qancha?
questions.explanation: Jami sharlar soni: 4 + 6 = 10. Qizil sharlar 4 ta. Ehtimollik: P = 4/10 = 0.4 yoki 40%.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Ketma-ketlikning keyingi sonini toping: 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, ?
questions.explanation: Bu geometrik progressiya bo'lib, har bir had oldingisini 2 ga ko'paytirish orqali hosil bo'ladi: 32 × 2 = 64.

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.question: Otasi 36 yoshda, o'g'li esa 6 yoshda. Necha yildan keyin ota o'g'lidan 3 barobar katta bo'ladi?
questions.explanation:
x yildan so'ng: 36 + x = 3(6 + x)
36 + x = 18 + 3x
36 - 18 = 3x - x
18 = 2x => x = 9 yildan keyin (Otasi 45, o'g'li 15 bo'ladi: 45 = 3 × 15).
